francisco.title: General Manager | Operations & major events | P&L, ×3.9 scaling and 28% EBITDA | UEFA · Vuelta España · Live Nation
francisco.text: Working with Miguel on the development of LegalPyme has been a very positive experience. Beyond his technical skills, I would highlight his ability to understand business needs and turn them into practical, functional solutions. Throughout the project he showed commitment, flexibility and a strong results orientation. Thank you, Miguel, for your dedication and professionalism throughout this journey.

andrea.title: Industrial Design Engineer | FTTH network project design | Graphic design, UI, 3D | Illustration
andrea.context: Andrea worked with Miguel in the same team
andrea.text:
I had the opportunity to work alongside Miguel on a project where he was responsible for the entire development of a web platform, including more complex features such as an interactive map, profile creation and management, registrations and a member directory, among others. He also does very good work on optimising and adapting the interface design, achieving a much more intuitive, fluid and efficient user experience.
As part of the project, he was also responsible for developing the mobile apps for Android and iOS.

Beyond his technical skills, I would also highlight the way he works: he is resourceful, ingenious, committed and very hard-working. He always looks for solutions to problems and is able to find practical alternatives in complex situations.

The experience of working with him has been excellent and I would undoubtedly recommend him for any project that requires technical ability, initiative and commitment.

laia.title: Emotional intelligence and empathetic communication specialist for wellbeing. Ontological coach. I support individuals, schools (students, teachers and families), companies and organisations.
laia.context: Laia was a client of Miguel
laia.text:
I have had the privilege of working with Miguel on the creation of my professional website (www.laiabobe.com) and I could not be happier with the result.

From the very first moment he understood the essence of my project and captured what I wanted to convey with my personal brand. It was very important to me that the website reflected who I am and the way I work, and Miguel achieved this beyond my expectations.

Throughout the whole process he stood out for his professionalism, his ability to listen and his commitment. He didn't just build a website: he contributed ideas, took care of every detail and was very willing to make the necessary adjustments until the result fully matched what I had in mind. At all times I felt heard, supported and well advised.

The final result is not only a well-designed and functional website, but one I feel fully represented by.

I recommend Miguel to any person or company looking for a rigorous, creative, committed professional with great human quality. If I ever need to develop another web project, I will not hesitate to work with him again. It has been a real pleasure to work with him.
